headline: Tony Y. and Rustam Bazarbayev climb into ARC-3 top 100

sections.text: Tony Y. gained 2.72 points to reach 33.92, moving from 334th to 62nd. Rustam Bazarbayev gained 2.04 to reach 33.44, moving from 296th to 86th on the ARC-AGI-3 public board.
Both are now inside the top 100; the last of 18 gold places is 18th at 38.20.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-3 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
